messages:
tom: Heads-up: NebulaWorks + BlueArc joint studio at Summit — Dec 3. Two segments: 09:30 PT "Marketplace Showcase" (announce NebulaWorks tile) and 11:00 PT "Integrator Studio" (hands-on SI + edge hardware). Need a short run-of-show, go/no-go checklist, and confirmation that the Marketplace tile goes live at 09:00 PT. Who can take which items?

nina (partnerships): Ill own partner comms with NebulaWorks & BlueArc. Confirmed speakers: NebulaWorks Head of Integrations (Lina) and BlueArc Solutions Lead (Marco). I need bios + headshots by Nov 24. Travel ETA for Lina?

carla (marketing): Marketing will do promo + co-branded tile creative. Ask: one-line hooks for both segments, and whether product wants a 72h embargo (compliance requested 72h pre-publication review).

ben (eng): Primary demo runs on NebulaWorks edge appliance onsite. Fallback: local container on USB + Redwood Dedicated snapshot served from a bonded LTE hotspot. Ill prepare the container, a failover script, and a health-check endpoint. Please confirm venue network egress.

sora (solutions): Demo scripts: (1) quick query + live embedding (2) SI deployment walkthrough. I'll make a 6-step technician checklist and keep slides minimal. Also will moderate technical Q&A.

mel (hw-ops): Shipping plan: 4 demo units, 2 spare PSUs, encrypted return labels. Pickup Nov 30. I need the on-site custodian name for sign-in (venue requires full name & phone). Also will image a local fallback USB with hashed checksum.

ops-bot: Event created: "NebulaWorks x BlueArc  Summit Studio: Marketplace + Integrator Lab" Dec 3, 09:30-12:00 PT. Rehearsal slots: Dec 2 16:00 PT (tech run) and Dec 3 08:00 PT (AV check). (thread_ts: 2945678901)

tom: AV check at 08:00 on day, micro-run 09:00. Need chat ops and embargo handling. Who will triage chat?

carla: Marketing will triage chat and handle embargo escalations. We can accept 72h review but need final speaker deck by Nov 28 so compliance can scan. Also booking a captioner + live translation (Spanish).

nina: NebulaWorks legal requests co-announcement copy by Nov 25 and asks for a 72h review window. Can marketing commit?

carla: 72h is doable. We'll schedule public push 72h post-recording. If legal flags anything we hold the release.

ben: Preflight health checks (run on the appliance):

```
# appliance health
curl -sfS http://localhost:8081/health
# quick generate to verify model & kv store
curl -sfS -X POST http://localhost:8081/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize release notes","max_tokens":90}'
```

sora: I'll put the step-by-step lab script in /docs/events/nebula-integrator-lab.md by Nov 26 and a compact runbook for on-site techs.

mel: Shipping manifest uploaded. Tracking NW-445-RT. Return labels & custodian form attached to the drive. On-site custodian: "Carlos Vega" (phone +1-415-555-0199).

tom: Action owners summary:
- Nina: partner comms, bios/headshots, co-announcement draft
- Carla: promo + tile creative, embargo coordination, captions/translation
- Ben: container image, failover script, vault creds
- Sora: demo script, moderator, runbook
- Mel: shipping, custodian, fallback USB image

Please ack and flag blockers.

nina: Ack. Bios by Nov 24. Legal may request minor copy edits.

carla: Ack. Promo draft Nov 22. Captioner & translator booked.

ben: Ack. Ill provision temporary demo creds in the vault (expires Dec 4) and post the container hash.

sora: Ack. Runbook by Nov 26. Will handle live moderation.

mel: Ack. Courier booked.

tom: One more ask: can each owner confirm theyve uploaded artifacts to the shared event folder (slides, scripts, images) by Nov 29? Ill send the final run-of-show Nov 30. If network or device state changes update this thread. :thumbsup:
